prompt.name: Name the channel
prompt.base_url: Optional. Enter a relay API URL, e.g. one relayed through Cloudflare. The {model} variable is supported, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1/{model}/chat
prompt.key: Enter the authentication key for this channel
prompt.proxy: Proxy for this channel only; http and socks5 are supported, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:1080. Put `%s` in the proxy URL as a session placeholder: it is replaced with a unique session ID derived from the key.
prompt.test_model: Model used to test the channel; tests are unavailable when empty. Chat models only, e.g. gpt-3.5-turbo
prompt.models: Select the models this channel supports. You can also use a * wildcard, e.g. gpt-3.5* matches every model starting with gpt-3.5. The * may only appear at the end and must follow at least one character: gpt-3.5* is valid, *gpt-3.5 is not.
prompt.model_mapping: Model mapping: each line forwards the model name the user requests to the real upstream model name (e.g. opus-latest → claude-opus-4.8). Billing uses the real upstream model by default; tick "Bill on incoming" to bill by the requested name instead (price it under model pricing first).
prompt.model_headers: Custom request headers per model, e.g. {"key": "value"}
prompt.header_override: Pass client request headers through to the upstream. A value can be a fixed value, {api_key} (the channel key) or {client_header:X-Request-Id} (the client header of that name). Use * as the key to pass through every client header, or start the key with re: or regex: to pass through headers matching a regular expression. Note: authentication headers are handled by the channel and are never overridden. Use standard header casing for keys (e.g. X-Request-Id) so the same header is not sent with different casing.
prompt.custom_parameter: Inject extra parameters as JSON (nesting allowed). Control options: overwrite: true replaces fields of the same name; when unset or false, only missing fields are added. per_model: true applies the overrides per model name, e.g. {"per_model":true,"gpt-3.5-turbo":{"temperature": 0.7},"gpt-4":{"temperature": 0.5}}. pre_add: true applies the overrides as soon as the request arrives instead of just before it is sent upstream; works for all channels (including Claude and Gemini), e.g. {"pre_add":true,"overwrite":true,"stream":false}.
prompt.groups: Select the user groups this channel serves
prompt.only_chat: With chat only selected, requests that include function calls skip this channel
prompt.provider_models_list: Fill in all fields before fetching the model list
prompt.tag: Tag the channel to manage channels in bulk by tag. Note: once a tag is set, some settings can only be changed through the channel tag, not from the channel list.
prompt.pre_cost: Choose the pre-billing option used to estimate cost. If counting images takes too many resources, you can turn off image billing. Note: some channels return no token counts when streaming, which makes input token counts inaccurate.
prompt.disabled_stream: Models listed here have streaming disabled: streaming requests for these models skip this channel
prompt.allow_extra_body: When on, extra fields in the user's request (such as the OpenAI SDK's extra_body parameter) are passed through, for sending custom parameters to the upstream API
prompt.pass_through_body: When on, the client request body is forwarded upstream as is: only the mapped model name is rewritten, and unknown fields and the original bytes are kept. Useful for transparent proxying over the same protocol. Note: only OpenAI-protocol channels honor this (channels that build their own body, such as Claude and Gemini, ignore it); when on, extra-field merging is skipped (only the channel extra parameters still apply, at byte level).
prompt.apiVersionExample: Enter the default API version, e.g. {{example}}
prompt.keyFormatBaidu: Use the format APIKey|SecretKey. If the OpenAI API plugin is enabled, enter the API key directly
prompt.dashscopePlugin: Enter the plugin parameters, i.e. the value of the X-DashScope-Plugin request header
prompt.speechRegion: Enter the location/region of your Speech Studio, e.g. eastasia
prompt.proxyKey: Enter the {{service}} key; if it has no key set, any value works
prompt.proxyAddress: Enter the address where {{service}} is deployed
prompt.cozeModels: Model names take the form coze-{bot_id}; you can also use the coze-* wildcard to match every model starting with coze
prompt.cozeMapping: Model name mapping: use an easy-to-remember name instead of coze-{bot_id}, e.g. {"coze-translate": "coze-xxxxx"}. Note: with model mapping, the model names above must be the pre-mapping names; in this example, add coze-translate to the models (not needed if you already use coze-*).
prompt.ollamaUrl: Enter the address of your Ollama deployment, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434. If you use Cloudflare Zero Trust, enter the access credentials in the plugin settings below
prompt.keySeeDocs: See the documentation for how to get the key.
prompt.vertexRegion: Region|ProjectID or Region1|Region2|Region3|ProjectID (one of several regions is picked at random)
prompt.siliconflowUrl: The official API URL https://api.siliconflow.com is being retired; use https://api.siliconflow.cn
prompt.oauthJson: Enter the full OAuth2 credential JSON, or click "OAuth authorization" below to fetch it automatically
prompt.claudeOauth: Enter an access_token (sk-ant-sid01-xxx) or the full OAuth2 credential JSON, or click "OAuth authorization" below to fetch it automatically
prompt.gcpProjectId: Enter the Google Cloud project ID, e.g. my-project-123
prompt.projectIdOptional: Optional. Leave blank to detect it automatically or generate one at random, e.g. my-project-123
prompt.vertexExpressKey: Enter an API key (from the Google Cloud Console)
